QuestInfo.name: Perfect Picnic Day
QuestInfo.0: Poor Gaga has another serious problem. Go see what it is.
QuestInfo.1: Gaga told you that if you keep the Sunshine Doll safe for 30 minutes, it will become a Shining Sunshine Doll. Something seems odd about all this, but you might as well give it a try... \n
QuestInfo.2: The sky is dark and overcast, and on the day of the picnic, too! Hopefully, Gaga's wish for a clear, sunny day will come true.\n

0.0: Oh, no...this doesn't look good at all...\r\n#L0##bWhat's wrong?#l\n#k
0.1: Ah, hello, #b#h0##k. Look at the sky. The Spring Picnic is just around the corner, but it's been so cloudy lately... I can't even sleep because I'm worried about rain on the day of the picnic!\r\n#L0##bThat's terrible. Is there any way I can help?#l\n#k
0.2: Yes, actually, there is! If you take this #r#t03994263##k and carry it around for #b30 minutes#k#k, it will change into a #r#t03994264##k. When that happens, bring it back to me before the light goes out. According to the town's elder, if we collect enough of these Shining Sunshine Dolls, we will have clear skies on the day of the picnic. Can you do that?

yes.0: Great! #bThe Sunshine Doll will disappear if you log out#k, so try not to lose it. And when the Sunshine Doll starts to shine, don't forget to bring it back to me within #r3 hours#k!
yes.1: I'm counting on you, #b#h0##k! Help keep our skies clear!

no.0: What, you don't care if it rains on the day of the picnic? I hope you know what you're doing...

item.0: I don't think the Sunshine Doll is shiny enough yet.
